race: Formula 1 Qatar Airways Azerbaijan Grand Prix 2026

segments.speaker: paul
segments.text: Welcome to The Race Weekend Podcast, where the Baku streets are about to get very loud, and the title fight is about to get very hot again.

segments.speaker: michael
segments.text: Kimi Antonelli tells BBC Sport he is still finding his way after the crash in twenty twenty four stayed in his head for a long time.

segments.speaker: paul
segments.text: That is a big line from the championship leader, and he already has eight wins on the board, so trust that Mercedes car in a fast changing season.

segments.speaker: michael
segments.text: The other story is Isack Hadjar, because he is back in the Red Bull at Azerbaijan after his injury break, and that matters a lot here.

segments.speaker: paul
segments.text: And Red Bull have kept him for twenty twenty seven as Max Verstappen's team mate, which is a huge statement for the future and a big confidence boost.

segments.speaker: michael
segments.text: Formula One has also trimmed the maximum race distance by fifteen kilometres, so every stint feels sharper and more dangerous on a street track.

segments.speaker: paul
segments.text: We are deep into the season, the streets are tricky, and this is the kind of race where a title can wobble with both Mercedes drivers near the front.

segments.speaker: michael
segments.text: So why do we put Kimi first in our top ten, and why does the data keep pointing to Mercedes before the weekend starts when the championship is this close?

segments.speaker: paul
segments.text: His only Baku result was fourth, and that says he has real pace on this street circuit, even without a podium yet, and the confidence is there.

segments.speaker: michael
segments.text: George Russell is the obvious challenge, because he has two Baku podiums and his best finish there is second, and he knows how to manage pressure.

segments.speaker: paul
segments.text: I would take George for a clean race, but Kimi is the man to beat and the championship pressure is on everyone else, especially in a street race.

segments.speaker: michael
segments.text: Then there is Max, and that is where it gets dangerous, because Max is a Baku specialist and the pace is there, and the car is strong.

segments.speaker: paul
segments.text: Max has a Baku win, an average finish near third over three races, recent podiums, and strong pace to keep us honest, so we cannot sleep on him.

segments.speaker: michael
segments.text: So we take the Mercedes one and two, but Max is the wildcard we cannot ignore, because Baku rewards boldness.

segments.speaker: paul
segments.text: Deep cut time, and I am going with Isack Hadjar as our low confidence gamble for the weekend, and I think it will surprise some people.

segments.speaker: michael
segments.text: He is returning from injury, he has a Red Bull car, and his Baku best is tenth, so this is a points call with a story and a lot of momentum.

segments.speaker: paul
segments.text: Charles Leclerc and Lewis Hamilton make the top five, and Leclerc's recent top three form makes him dangerous, especially with Baku podium history.

segments.speaker: michael
segments.text: Hamilton is a title contender and consistent, but Baku has been weaker for him, so I keep him just behind Leclerc, but he can still score big.

segments.speaker: paul
segments.text: Lando Norris has recent wins and strong McLaren pace, and Oscar Piastri has the podium capability to hit the front, and both know this kind of race.

segments.speaker: michael
segments.text: Oscar also has a Baku win in the history books, so that McLaren fight for sixth and seventh is a proper scrap, and the fans will love it.

segments.speaker: paul
segments.text: Liam Lawson has a fifth at Baku, and the Racing Bulls car is strong enough to keep him in the top ten, and he drives with confidence.

segments.speaker: michael
segments.text: Arvid Lindblad is riding that Racing Bulls upgrade pace, and his recent top ten consistency is real, and the upgrade is helping.

segments.speaker: paul
segments.text: That is the Racing Bulls story, and I love how both cars can squeeze points out of a tricky street race without needing a miracle.

segments.speaker: michael
segments.text: Ready for the full list, because we have a clean top ten and no surprises in the order, and it is very fast.

segments.speaker: paul
segments.text: Here is our full top ten in order, and that is the call, Kimi Antonelli, George Russell, Max Verstappen, Charles Leclerc, Lewis Hamilton, Lando Norris, Oscar Piastri, Liam Lawson, Isack Hadjar, and Arvid Lindblad.

segments.speaker: michael
segments.text: Baku is ready, the title fight is hot, and the street circuit never misses, and the energy is huge.

segments.speaker: paul
segments.text: See you at the Azerbaijan Grand Prix, keep it tight, and let us go with a big smile.
